title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of a Guiding Hand — Episode6 Words That I Can Say

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand
meta.Episode: Episode6 — Words That I Can Say
meta.Event Outline: With so much on their plate, it's getting harder for MORE MORE JUMP! to keep on top of their schedule. Shizuku suggests that Saito become the group's manager since she's proven her talents to them, but things are not so simple...

rows.Line: Ryusuiso - Peony Room

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Huh?
Shizuku, you're back already?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was quick.
Were the baths not open yet?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, they were...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But there's something I need to discuss with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Did something happen just now?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Saito's grandmother is okay with her granddaughter not taking over because she wants her to be happy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, doesn't that give Saito the green light to start pursuing her dream?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... She still said she was gonna take over even after she heard what her grandmother had to say.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. Which is why...I'm not sure as to what to do right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is a family matter, so we don't really have any right to butt in... But if she goes through with this, I feel that neither she nor her family will end up benefitting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I'm still confused as to why she's so set on taking over running this inn.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... Saito's mother did say she's looking forward to her becoming the next proprietress. Maybe she doesn't want to let her down?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I think that's only a part of it.
I'm guessing that she feels a sense of duty.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Remember what she said when we first got here...? She said, “I'm an only child...”>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Expectations... Duty...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think I understand how she feels.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because when I was still in Cheerful * Days, I felt that I couldn't disappoint anyone and that I had a duty to fulfill.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Before I became an idol, I wasn't nearly as good a speaker as Airi was, and it always took me so long to make any decisions...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because of that, I couldn't accept myself like I do now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But my friends submitted an application to audition for me, and I somehow ended up winning the Grand Prix...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I did, I finally came to the belief that even someone like me could help others by being an idol.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I felt that I couldn't disappoint anyone back then...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, I was chosen to become the lead, which gave me a strong sense of needing to fulfill my duty. And while those feelings did fuel me for a time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As you all know, they weren't enough to keep me going.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't want Saito to suffer the same fate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, if it's going to make everyone happy in the end, then I want Saito to pursue her real dreams...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Why don't you tell her what you just said?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree...
I think she'd respond really well to what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, Shizuku, I feel like you're the only one who can make all that clear to Saito. So I think you should go talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Only I can...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
Then, I'll try talking to her.
Lobby

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Wait, do we still have enough beer in stock? I need to check the inventory list after I'm done taking my break.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Then, I have to start prepping for breakfast. We're supposed to serve salmon tomorrow, so I'm sure Minori won't know what to do with herself, and...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (My mind keeps wandering every chance it gets.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I thought I'd gotten over all that yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Until just a little while ago, my event job partly felt almost like a hobby.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I gained such a huge interest in that line of work after shaking hands with Shizuku...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I knew that I'd have to take over here someday, so I figured even a part-time job in the industry would do. But...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Seeing everyone shine on stage and the way the crowd reacted... I wanted to make more of that happen. I was willing to give it everything I had.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I even started learning about how to be a manager. But I began taking things so seriously that I started forgetting about this place...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
(No, I didn't forget.
I kept myself from remembering.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Now I'm paying the price for that...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I kept doing what I wanted to while pushing aside my obligations...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
(I knew that wouldn't last...
I knew this time would come sooner or later.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (But I have to forget about all that now. After all, I'm an only child...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I can't let my whims cause it to go out of business. And Mom's looking forward to me taking over.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
(So...I'm okay with my decision.
I mean, I don't want this inn to close down.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Yes. This is fine.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Or... It should be...)

rows.Speaker: Young Child
rows.Line: Wait, Daddy, we're going home tomorrow?!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Yes, honey. We're only here until tomorrow morning. After that, we'll be taking the car home.

rows.Speaker: Young Child
rows.Line:
No, I don't wanna go!
I wanna stay here forever!

rows.Speaker: Young Child
rows.Line: The food's so yummy! And the bathwater feels all weird and slippery! I really like it here! I don't wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Haha. You're putting me in a tough spot. But we can always come again next year. Who knows? Maybe they'll serve something even more yummy and delicious then!

rows.Speaker: Young Child
rows.Line:
Wait....really?!
Then, we should come back again next year!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I should get back to work.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I need to check on our inventory and start prepping for breakfast while I still have—
Saito!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...?
